rich_description: The Career Conversion Programme (CCP) is Workforce Singapore's flagship mid-career switch scheme. Participating employers hire mid-career individuals into roles they would not normally qualify for on paper, then put them through 3-12 months of structured on-the-job and classroom training to bring them up to speed. Throughout the training period, WSG reimburses the employer up to 70% of the trainee's monthly salary (90% for mature workers aged 40+, ex-offenders, persons with disabilities, and long-term unemployed). The trainee draws a normal salary from day one — this is not a stipend or scholarship. CCPs run across roughly 30 growth sectors including infocomm, healthcare, advanced manufacturing, professional services, financial services, and the green economy. Suited to: someone retrenched from a shrinking sector, a homemaker returning to work, a mid-career professional whose previous skills are obsolete. You don't apply to WSG directly — you apply to a CCP-listed job opening at a participating employer, and the conversion package kicks in on hire.

other_criteria: Hired by a CCP-participating employer into a new role under the programme
Have not received CCP support for the same job role at the same company before
Mature workers 40+, long-term unemployed (6+ months), ex-offenders, and persons with disabilities qualify for higher 90% salary support tier

required_documents.name: Resume or work history
required_documents.notes: Used by the employer to assess the conversion plan

required_documents.name: Educational certificates
required_documents.required_if: if relevant to the new role

required_documents.name: Last drawn payslip or income tax NOA

oth_location: WSG Careers Connect at Tampines OTH (CareersFinder counter). Officers help match jobseekers to CCP-listed openings and can refer to the WSG-paired Career Matching Provider for the sector.
typical_processing_time: Job matching and interview timeline depends on the employer; CCP approval is bundled into the hire — once the offer is accepted the training package starts immediately.
